claimer_behavior.claim_attribution_methodology: Fungible oDOLO provenance is estimated per wallet: claimed allocation is assigned to exercise first, then external outflow, with the residual reported as claim remaining. Held is an independent current balanceOf(wallet) value and is not part of that partition.

balance_reconciliation.methodology: Current oDOLO balances are fetched with balanceOf(wallet) for every address seen in the Transfer ledger plus self-healing candidates from previous oDOLO snapshots, oDOLO claim events, exerciser history, and oDOLO-routed veDOLO locks.
